laya_question.test_case_answer: Right to reside in the shared household under PWDVA s.17 — never 'tenancy rights'.

sections.outcome: Residence claim filed on proved shared-household facts; interim protection sought urgently if eviction is imminent
prerequisites: Proof of residence in the house: address proof, utility bills, ration card/Aadhaar showing the address, photographs, neighbour/witness statements, any communication showing she lived there
facts of the eviction threats (who threatened, when, in what words)
sections.relief: Right to reside in the shared household (s.17); protection order (s.18); residence order restraining eviction or securing alternate accommodation (s.19)
sections.title: Document — residence proof for the shared household (house in husband's name, eviction threats)
sections.when_used: Before filing the PWDVA ss.17/18/19 claim: prove the house is the shared household where the wife lived as part of the domestic relationship.
